decision_note: User clarified packages/shared changes are allowed; mobile-shell remains forbidden.
summary: Implemented YoPayment deposit-create flow by adding a shared profile service, exporting it, passing amount into YoPayment from second-step, and replacing the YoPayment stub with a guarded react-query mutation that validates payload with zod and calls yopayment/deposit/create.json. No mobile-shell changes and no new libraries.
notes: Rico and Kowalski artifacts were returned inline due tool write limitations before implementation proceeded.
Melman verdict PASS with one non-blocking note: YoPayment currently auto-submits on mount only, so later amount prop changes would not retrigger submission unless component remounts.
